- Watch out: Your old apps never show what you save here: a phone shows it only once a build of this app is installed, a test build from Build & test first.
- Done when: The phone's sign-in screen shows your texts, buttons and pictures.
- Go deeper: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/), [How to check the sign-in screen before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/check-preview/)

## Something's wrong?

- **Sign-in & registration asks you to choose the events in Events & updates first.** Why: No event is chosen for the app yet, and these settings are kept per event. What to do: In Events & updates, choose the event or the event tags and save, then choose an event in Event. See: [How to choose how people sign in to an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/choose-sign-in-mode/), [Events & updates](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-general/).
- **Events & updates says “No event has a tag yet. Tag your events in your admin first.”** Why: Several events, by event tag is chosen, and no event in your ExpoPlatform admin has a tag yet. What to do: Tag your events in your ExpoPlatform admin, then come back. See: [How to make the app offer several events, chosen by event tag](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-general/choose-events-by-tag/).
- **My changes disappeared when I picked another event or language.** Why: In Menu & content, Sign-in & registration and Events & updates, switching the event or the language drops unsaved changes without asking. What to do: Make the changes again, and save before you switch. See: [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/).
- **A change I made under one language shows in every language.** Why: Only the button texts are kept per language; the sign-in mode, the addresses and the switches hold one value for every language. What to do: Set those once for each event, and write only the button texts in each language. See: [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/).
- **The register button does not show on the sign-in screen.** Why: It shows only while Show the register button is on and there is a registration address to open. What to do: Switch it on and save; with Another website, fill in Registration website, and with The event's registration page, the event needs a registration page of its own to open. See: [How to let new visitors register from the sign-in screen](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/add-register-button/), [Sign-in & registration: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/fields/).
- **Saving says “This could not be saved - try again” or “Reopen App Studio from your admin”.** Why: The first means the save did not go through, and your edits stay in the form; the second means your App Studio session has ended. What to do: For the first, press Save changes again; for the second, open App Studio again from your ExpoPlatform admin and make the change again. See: [How to choose how people sign in to an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/choose-sign-in-mode/), [Open App Studio](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/open/).
- **There is no phone beside the form, or it shows “Loading the preview…” or “The app's config could not be loaded…”** Why: The preview shows only on wide screens and can stay loading when its data is refused; the second message means the preview could not get what it needs to start. What to do: Use a wider window; if it stays loading, wait a moment, then open the section again; for the second message, try again in a minute. See: [How to check the sign-in screen before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/check-preview/).
- **The sign-in screen still shows the old pictures.** Why: Sign-in & registration cannot change them, and its preview draws the event's stored ones; Colours & fonts sets them, and the app uses them only after Save changes there. What to do: In Colours & fonts, with the right event picked, set them under Pictures, press Save changes, and check them there with Boot flow. See: [How to check the sign-in screen before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/check-preview/), [How to change the sign-in pictures and the loading backdrop](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/design/change-sign-in-pictures/), [Colours & fonts: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/design/fields/).
- **Phones still show the old sign-in screen.** Why: Installed apps show saved changes the next time they refresh, and only saved changes reach them; your old apps never show them. What to do: Check that you saved each event and language you changed, and that the phone has a build of this app, such as a test build from Build & test; it then shows them at its next refresh. See: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to check the sign-in screen before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/check-preview/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/).

# Journey: Build the menu and content

From each event's menu in App Studio to the features and pages people find in the app.

**The result:** Each event's menu holds the features and pages each kind of person needs, named, ordered and shown to the right people, and installed builds of this app show it at their next refresh.

Sources: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/).

_App Studio Playbook v1.0.0, built from the App Studio guide v1.0.1, checked against App Studio bea65df on 14 Oct 2026. Each step links to the App Studio guide pages it comes from._

## Who does what

- **Your move**: You build each event's menu in App Studio, in Menu & content: its items, their order, names and icons, the bottom bar and who sees each item.

Sources: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/).

## Before you start, have ready

- Your app's events chosen in Events & updates: until then, Menu & content shows only a message asking you to choose them.
- For each event, the features and pages each kind of person needs, and the items, four at most, that should be tabs of the bottom bar.
- Names of up to 20 characters for items and section headers, in each language your app offers.
- Any icons of your own: App Studio asks for “A square PNG, one colour on a transparent background, at least 48 px.”
- Your own pages, written and saved in Custom pages, if you want them in the menu.
- Files for a documents page: PDF, Word or Excel, of up to 20 MB each.
- For a contacts page: each person's details, and photos as PNG or JPEG files of up to 10 MB.

Sources: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [Events & updates](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-general/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/), [How to rename a menu section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-section/), [How to put a saved page in the menu](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/add-a-page-to-the-menu/), [How to add documents to a documents page](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-documents/), [How to fill a contacts page](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fill-contacts/).

## Stage 1: Put your pages in, then open the menu

Each event of your app has its own menu, in four sections. Item names, section headers and page content are kept per language; everything else is one setting for all languages.

Sources: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/).

### 1. If you wrote pages in Custom pages, press Add to menu on each one listed under Not in the menu.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Add to menu, Edit
- Why: It goes to the end of the Event section at once, and installed builds of this app show it on their next refresh, with no new build.
- Watch out: If Menu & content is already open in another tab, reload it before you save there, or its save takes the page out of the menu again.
- Watch out: In Menu & content, a page listed as “Page title” has no name yet: press Edit and name it, or the menu cannot be saved.
- Done when: The page's row reads In the menu.
- Go deeper: [How to put a saved page in the menu](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/add-a-page-to-the-menu/), [How to write a page of your own](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/write-a-page/), [Custom pages](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/)

### 2. Open Menu & content, pick the event in Event, and the language if your app has more than one.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Menu & content, in the menu of sections on the left, a screenshot of App Studio
- Watch out: Switching the event or the language drops unsaved changes without asking: press Save changes first.
- Watch out: Language of the texts starts on English each time the section opens: pick your language before you edit its texts.
- Watch out: Change this app's menu here from now on: later changes in the old App Builder no longer reach it, and nothing you save here changes your old apps.
- Done when: Menu & content shows that event's menu, with its names in that language.
- Go deeper: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Glossary](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/glossary/)

## Stage 2: Add the features and pages people need

Add each item to the section whose people need it. In the app, “Event (everyone)” is shown to everyone, signed in or not; “My account (participants)” to signed-in people except exhibitor company owners; “My company (team members)” to signed-in team members; and “My company (exhibitor)” to signed-in exhibitor company owners.

Sources: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/).

### 3. In a section, choose a feature, A custom page or A documents page in Add to this section, and press Add.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Section header, Add to this section, Add
- Why: The item goes at the end of the section with its own name and icon, seen by everyone who sees the section, and not in the bottom bar.
- Watch out: Add to this section offers only the features switched on for the event and not already in the section.
- Watch out: Save in an item's window saves the whole menu at once, with every other unsaved change on the page.
- Watch out: If people already use this app, fill a new page and set Visible for in its window before you save.
- Done when: The new item is the last row of its section, unsaved until you press Save in its window or Save changes.
- Go deeper: [How to add a feature, a custom page or a documents page to a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-item/), [How to add a built-in screen to the menu](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/add-a-built-in-screen/), [How to limit who sees an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/limit-audience/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/)

## Stage 3: Fill in the menu's own pages

Which kinds of page you can add depends on what the event offers, and each is filled in its item's window, which keeps your changes only when you press Save. Its tabs, documents, contacts and networks are kept per language, so fill them in the language you picked when you opened Menu & content, while a web page address is one for all languages.

Sources: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [How to write a custom page](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/write-custom-page/), [Glossary](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/glossary/), [Menu & content: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fields/).

### 4. Press Edit on a custom page, fill its tabs, or switch Open a web page instead on, and press Save.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Open a web page instead, Tab name, Title, Text, Background colour, Background picture, Add a tab
- Why: A custom page holds your own tabs, with their names, titles, texts and backgrounds, or a web page that opens in their place.
- Watch out: Web page address has no format check in App Studio, so check the address before you save.
- Watch out: Remove the tab removes a tab at once, without asking.
- Watch out: A page built with the old App Builder's blocks opens as “Text (HTML)” and stays HTML, to keep every block.
- Done when: App Studio says “Saved”, and the item's window closes.
- Go deeper: [How to write a custom page](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/write-custom-page/), [How to edit a page made before App Studio](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/edit-old-page/), [Menu & content: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fields/)

### 5. Press Edit on a documents page, add each file with Add a document (PDF, Word, Excel), and press Save.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Document 1, Add a document (PDF, Word, Excel), Open, Remove
- Why: The page lists each document under the name in its box, which starts as the file's name without its extension.
- Watch out: A file uploads as soon as you choose it, but joins the page only when you press Save.
- Watch out: Remove takes a document off the page at once, without asking.
- Done when: App Studio says “Saved”, and the item's window closes.
- Go deeper: [How to add documents to a documents page](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-documents/), [Menu & content: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fields/)

### 6. If the menu has a contacts page, press Edit on it, add each person with Add a contact, and press Save.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Group, Job title, First name, Last name, Phone, Email, Photo, Add a contact
- Watch out: Phone and Email are not checked for format, so check each one before you save.
- Watch out: Remove takes a contact off at once, without asking.
- Done when: App Studio says “Saved”, and the item's window closes.
- Go deeper: [How to fill a contacts page](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fill-contacts/), [Menu & content: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fields/)

### 7. On a social media item, press Edit, tick the networks under Show these social networks, and press Save.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Show these social networks
- Why: The item carries only the networks you tick: Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube or Pinterest.
- Watch out: On a newly added item none is ticked, so it carries no network until you tick one.
- Done when: App Studio says “Saved”, and the item's window closes.
- Go deeper: [How to choose the social networks of a social media item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-social/), [Menu & content: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fields/)

## Stage 4: Make things easy to find

Name and order each section's items, and choose up to four items of the event's whole menu as tabs of the app's bottom bar.

Sources: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/).

### 8. Name each section in Section header, order its items with Move up and Move down, and press Save changes.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Section header, Bottom bar, Move up, Move down, Edit, Remove from the menu
- Why: In the app's menu, the header is the section's title, and the section lists its items in your order.
- Watch out: Items move only within their own section.
- Watch out: A section header you empty and save stays empty.
- Done when: On a wide screen, the preview's menu shows your headers and order, and App Studio said “Saved”.
- Go deeper: [How to change the order of items in a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/reorder/), [How to rename a menu section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-section/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/)

### 9. Press Edit on an item, change its Name in the menu and its Icon, and press Save.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Name in the menu, Icon, Cancel, Save
- Why: The name is the item's title in the app's menu, and on its tab when it is in the bottom bar.
- Watch out: Names are kept per language: rename the item in each language, and save before you switch.
- Watch out: An icon you upload must be a PNG: App Studio refuses a JPEG.
- Done when: App Studio says “Saved”, and the item's window closes.
- Go deeper: [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/), [Menu & content: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fields/)

### 10. Switch Bottom bar on for up to four items, in the order you want the tabs, and press Save changes.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Bottom bar (on), Move up, Move down, Edit, Remove from the menu
- Why: In the app, the items become tabs of the bottom bar, beside the menu button, for the people who can see each item.
- Watch out: The tabs follow the order in which you switched them on, not the items' places: to reorder them, switch them off and on again.
- Watch out: A hidden item with Bottom bar on still takes one of the four places.
- Done when: The line above the sections counts the places used, out of four, and App Studio said “Saved”.
- Go deeper: [How to put items in the bottom bar](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/bottom-bar/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to hide or remove an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/hide-or-remove/)

## Stage 5: Choose who sees each item

With nothing limited, everyone who sees a section sees its items. You can limit an item to some signed-in people, show a custom page to guests only, or hide an item.

Sources: [How to limit who sees an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/limit-audience/), [How to show a custom page to guests only](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/guests-only-page/), [How to hide or remove an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/hide-or-remove/).

### 11. Press Edit on an item, tick who should see it under Visible for, and press Save.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Name in the menu, Visible for, Hide this item, Cancel, Save
- Why: The item then shows only to the signed-in people your ticks match.
- Watch out: Once anything is ticked, people who are not signed in no longer see the item, even with All visitors ticked.
- Watch out: If you tick exhibitor choices, check the menu with View as set to Exhibitor (company owner) after you save.
- Done when: The item's row reads “Limited to some people”.
- Go deeper: [How to limit who sees an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/limit-audience/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/)

### 12. In a custom page's window, switch Only for people who are not signed in on, and press Save.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Name in the menu, Visible for, Hide this item, Only for people who are not signed in (on), Cancel, Save
- Why: Signed-in people no longer see the page in the app's menu; people who are not signed in do.
- Watch out: The switch is offered only for custom pages in the “Event (everyone)” section; for a page from Custom pages, listed as “Your page”, Who sees it on its blocks there can show each block to guests only.
- Done when: In the preview, on a wide screen, the page shows with View as set to Guest (not signed in), and not as a Visitor.
- Go deeper: [How to show a custom page to guests only](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/guests-only-page/), [How to show a block only to guests or only to signed-in people](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/limit-a-block/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/)

### 13. To keep an item in App Studio but out of the app, switch Hide this item on in its window and press Save.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Name in the menu, Visible for, Hide this item (on), Cancel, Save
- Why: The app then leaves the item out completely: no menu row, no tab, no tile.
- Watch out: Remove from the menu does not ask first: once you save, the item is gone from this event's menu in every language, with its content.
- Done when: The item's row reads “Hidden”.
- Go deeper: [How to hide or remove an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/hide-or-remove/)

## Stage 6: Check and save

The phone beside the form shows your unsaved menu as the kind of person you choose. Only saved changes reach installed builds of this app, the next time they refresh, with no new build.

Sources: [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/).

### 14. In the phone preview, pick each kind of person in View as, then open the menu and tap through it.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “Open the menu in the phone to see your changes. Saved changes reach the app itself.”
- Why: View as offers Guest (not signed in), Visitor, Exhibitor (company owner), Team member, Speaker and Moderator, and saves nothing.
- Watch out: The preview shows only on wide screens.
- Watch out: A change made in an item's window shows in the preview only after you press Save there, which saves it at once.
- Done when: The phone preview shows the menu you want for each kind of person.
- Go deeper: [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/)

### 15. Press Save changes, then add the texts in each other language, and build each other event's menu in Event.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: **Saved** “Changes reach the app the next time it refreshes.”
- Why: Installed builds of this app show the saved menu the next time they refresh, with no new build.
- Watch out: Your ExpoPlatform team can also change an event's menu: what they save shows in Menu & content, and what you save is what the app shows.
- Watch out: A document, a picture or an icon of your own is stored as soon as it is uploaded, even if the menu is never saved.
- Watch out: Your old apps never show what you save here: a phone shows it only once a build of this app is installed, a test build from Build & test first.
- Done when: App Studio says “Saved” for each event's menu, in each language.
- Go deeper: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [Add a new app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/new-app/)

## Something's wrong?

- **A page I put in the menu from Custom pages is gone from it.** Why: Menu & content was already open in another tab, and its save took the page out of the menu again. What to do: Put the page back with Add to menu in Custom pages, then reload Menu & content before you save there. See: [How to put a saved page in the menu](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/add-a-page-to-the-menu/).
- **Menu & content only asks you to choose the event, or the event tags, in Events & updates.** Why: The app's event, or for an app with several events its event tags, is not chosen yet. What to do: Choose them in Events & updates and save, then pick an event in Event. See: [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Events & updates](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-general/).
- **My changes disappeared when I picked another event or language.** Why: In Menu & content, Sign-in & registration and Events & updates, switching the event or the language drops unsaved changes without asking. What to do: Make the changes again, and save before you switch. See: [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/).
- **What I want to add is not in Add to this section.** Why: It offers only the features switched on for the event and not already in the section, and A custom page or A documents page only while the event has a free place of that kind. What to do: Look for the item in the section, perhaps marked “Hidden”; a feature not switched on for the event, or a kind of page with no free place, cannot be added here. See: [How to add a feature, a custom page or a documents page to a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-item/), [Glossary](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/glossary/).
- **Saving the menu says “Every menu item needs a name”.** Why: An item has no name, for example a page from Custom pages that Menu & content shows as “Page title”, so the menu was not saved. What to do: Press Edit on that item, give it a name, and save again. See: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to add a feature, a custom page or a documents page to a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-item/), [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/).
- **The Bottom bar switches are greyed out, or App Studio says “At most 4 items fit in the bottom navigation”.** Why: All four places are taken, a hidden item with Bottom bar on included, or more are on, for example items taken over from the old App Builder. What to do: Switch items off until four or fewer are on, then save; to add another tab, switch one off first. See: [How to put items in the bottom bar](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/bottom-bar/), [How to hide or remove an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/hide-or-remove/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [Menu & content: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fields/).
- **An item does not show for some people.** Why: It is hidden, limited under Visible for, a custom page shown to guests only, or in a section those people do not see. What to do: Check its row for “Hidden” or “Limited to some people”, a custom page's window for Only for people who are not signed in, and the menu in the preview with View as. See: [How to limit who sees an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/limit-audience/), [How to hide or remove an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/hide-or-remove/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [How to show a custom page to guests only](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/guests-only-page/).
- **There is no phone preview beside the menu.** Why: The preview shows only on wide screens. What to do: Open Menu & content on a wide screen. See: [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/).
- **A saved change does not show on phones yet.** Why: Installed builds of this app get saved changes the next time they refresh; an app made before App Studio never gets them, and a phone without a build of this app has nothing to refresh. What to do: Check that App Studio said “Saved”, then look on a test build of this app from Build & test after its next refresh. See: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/), [Add a new app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/new-app/).

# Journey: Get people using the app

From a widget's switch to the new version that carries it, and from your game's wording to drawing the prize.

**The result:** The home-screen widgets you chose ship in a new version of your app, and your event runs Play & Win and you draw the prize from its entries.

Sources: [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/).

_App Studio Playbook v1.0.0, built from the App Studio guide v1.0.1, checked against App Studio bea65df on 14 Oct 2026. Each step links to the App Studio guide pages it comes from._

## Who does what

- **Your move**: You set up Play & Win for each event in App Studio and draw the prize from its entries; you choose the home-screen widgets, make a new build and ask to publish it.
- **Our team is on it**: Your ExpoPlatform team switches the app's AI assistant on, which Ask the assistant needs; they approve your request to publish the new version and start its rollout, and can change the same Play & Win settings from their own admin.
- **The store is on it**: Apple and Google review the new version before people can download it.

Sources: [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/).

## Before you start, have ready

- For the widgets, an app you can build: ExpoPlatform must have set it up in the App Store and Google Play.
- For Ask the assistant, the app's AI assistant, which your ExpoPlatform team switches on, and the AI Synapsium block on your Home screen, which gives the widget its title, its line and the assistant's name.
- An event in your app: Play & Win runs per event, and each event has its own game and entries.
- Your own wording for any Play & Win text you want to change, in each language you need.
- Your picture for the game, a PNG or JPEG of up to 10 MB, and the web address for the Book a meeting button if you want one.
- For the stand kiosk, an iPad: it opens the kiosk link in Safari.

Sources: [How to build the app for a phone](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/start-a-build/), [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Home screen blocks and home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home-blocks-vs-widgets/), [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to change the wording of a Play & Win screen](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/edit-texts/), [How to set the game's picture and the Book a meeting link](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/picture-and-link/), [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/).

## Stage 1: Choose your home-screen widgets

There are three widgets, Event stats, My agenda and Ask the assistant, set once for the whole app, which people place on their phone's own home screen. Start early: a widget you switch on ships with your next build, so switch it on before your app's first build, or ship it in a new version.

Sources: [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/), [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/).

### 1. In Home-screen widgets, press a widget's switch so that it reads On.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The Event stats switch, reading Off, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: A widget you switch on ships with your next build, so people can add it to their phone's home screen.
- Watch out: The switch saves at once, with the widget's last saved counters and colours, never unsaved ones.
- Watch out: Ask the assistant needs the app's AI assistant, which your ExpoPlatform team switches on; until then App Studio warns that this widget “would have nothing to open”.
- Watch out: Switching a widget off works the same way: your next build leaves it out, so people cannot add it to their home screen.
- Done when: App Studio confirms with the widget's name and “is on. It ships with your next build.”
- Go deeper: [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Home screen blocks and home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home-blocks-vs-widgets/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/), [How to take a widget out of your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-off/)

### 2. For Event stats, while it is on, choose up to three counters, in order, and press Save changes.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Counters, in order, with the three default counters, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Event stats shows up to three counters, in your order, and each person sees their own numbers.
- Watch out: Three counters are chosen at first, so the other buttons are hidden: remove one to add another (“Up to 3 counters. Remove one to swap it.”).
- Watch out: With no counter chosen, Save changes is held back: add one (“Choose at least one counter.”).
- Watch out: These are not the counters of the Stats at a glance block on the app's Home screen, which has its own list, set per event.
- Done when: App Studio says “Widgets saved”.
- Go deeper: [How to choose what Event stats counts](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/counters/), [How to go back to a widget's default settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/defaults/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/), [Home-screen widgets: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/fields/), [Home screen blocks and home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home-blocks-vs-widgets/)

### 3. Under each widget's Colours, choose Light or dark or Brand colour, and press Save changes.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Colours for My agenda, with the Light and Dark preview cards, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Light or dark follows the phone's light or dark mode, and Brand colour gives the widget your brand colour.
- Watch out: Colours can be changed only while the widget is on.
- Done when: The preview shows a Light and a Dark card, or one Brand colour card, and you pressed Save changes.
- Go deeper: [How to choose a widget's colours](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/colours/), [How to go back to a widget's default settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/defaults/)

## Stage 2: Ship the widgets in a new version

Switching a widget on or off reaches phones only with a new build: a test build first, then a store release, after ExpoPlatform's approval, the store's review and the rollout.

Sources: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/).

### 4. Make a new build in Build & test, check it on your phone, and publish it as a new version.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The Build & test button at the top of every page of your app, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: A new version goes the same way as your first: build, test, Submit to the stores, ExpoPlatform's approval, the store's review and the rollout.
- Watch out: A later iPhone version, and Android beyond its first 5%, wait for your ExpoPlatform team to start the rollout: ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Watch out: On iPhone, the set-up step “Home-screen widgets ready” in Publish is done by your ExpoPlatform team, or by a signed iOS build, and does not block a release.
- Done when: The new version's release reads Live on Releases.
- Step by step: [Release a new version](update.md)
- Go deeper: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [How to build the app for a phone](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/start-a-build/), [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/)

## Stage 3: Make the game your own

Play & Win is a guessing game: attendees guess a number, agree to a separate consent, and you draw the prize from the entries. Each event runs its own game: read and set its texts, picture and link before you switch it on.

Sources: [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/).

### 5. In Play & Win, under Texts, read each screen's wording, one language at a time, change what you want, and save.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Texts, with the language box and the Voting screen card, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Your text replaces the app's own wording in that language only; texts you leave alone keep the app's wording.
- Watch out: With several events, pick the event in Event first: Save Play & Win saves the selected event only.
- Watch out: Consent holds the separate consent an attendee ticks before the vote is sent: changing it, in any language, makes a new consent version once you save.
- Watch out: A text marked No default shows nothing in that language: type your own text for it.
- Done when: Each card you changed shows how many texts are yours, such as “1 edited”, and you pressed Save Play & Win.
- Go deeper: [How to change the wording of a Play & Win screen](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/edit-texts/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/)

### 6. Under Picture and link, upload your picture, add a “Book a meeting” link if you want one, and save.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Picture, with Upload, beside the “Book a meeting” link, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Your picture replaces the trophy cups, and the final screen's Book a meeting button opens your link outside the app.
- Watch out: The picture is stored as soon as it is uploaded, or fetched from a link you paste in Or paste a link to a picture, but this event uses it only after Save Play & Win.
- Watch out: With no link, the final screen shows no Book a meeting button.
- Done when: Your picture's thumbnail shows under Picture, and you saved.
- Go deeper: [How to set the game's picture and the Book a meeting link](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/picture-and-link/), [Play & Win: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/fields/)

## Stage 4: Switch Play & Win on and try it

Once Play & Win is on and saved, and in the event's menu, signed-in attendees see it there; Test mode lets you try it before the event starts.

Sources: [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to try Play & Win before the event starts](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/test-early/).

### 7. In Play & Win, switch Play & Win on for your event and press Save Play & Win.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The Play & Win switch at the top of Play & Win, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Signed-in attendees then see Play & Win in the event's menu, as long as Play & Win is in that menu.
- Watch out: With several events, pick the event in Event first: Save Play & Win saves the selected event only.
- Done when: App Studio says “Play & Win saved — attendees get it the next time they open the page”.
- Go deeper: [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/)

### 8. Check that Play & Win is in the event's menu, in Menu & content.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Menu & content in the sidebar, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: The app's menu shows the Play & Win row only to signed-in people, only when the event's menu carries the row, and only while the campaign is on.
- Watch out: Menu & content shows one event at a time, and switching the event drops unsaved changes without asking: save first.
- Watch out: If it is not there, ask your ExpoPlatform contact to add it.
- Done when: You see Play & Win in the event's menu in Menu & content.
- Go deeper: [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/)

### 9. Switch Test mode on and save, then try voting in the app while signed in.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Test mode, under the Play & Win switch, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Voting then opens before the event starts, and still closes when the event ends.
- Watch out: Test mode opens voting for everyone who can see Play & Win, not only for you.
- Watch out: A vote made while testing is a real entry: it shows in Entries and counts as that person's one entry for the event.
- Watch out: If voting should then wait for the event, switch Test mode off and save again.
- Done when: Your test vote shows in Entries after you press Refresh.
- Go deeper: [How to try Play & Win before the event starts](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/test-early/), [Play & Win: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/fields/)

## Stage 5: Let visitors play on the stand iPad

Visitors without the app type their name, company and e-mail on the stand iPad, guess, and enter the same draw. One e-mail plays once, in the app or on the kiosk.

Sources: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/).

### 10. Under Kiosk (stand iPad), switch Kiosk on and press Save Play & Win.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The Kiosk switch, off; switched on, it shows the QR code and the Kiosk link, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Switching it on creates the kiosk's private link and its QR code, and the link works once you save.
- Watch out: As App Studio says, “Anyone with this link can enter the draw from it, so share it only with the stand team.”
- Watch out: Play & Win itself must be on too: while it is off, the kiosk shows “Voting is closed”.
- Watch out: The kiosk has its own consent, separate from the app's: unless you reword it in Consent text, under Kiosk (stand iPad), the English one reads “By playing Play & Win you agree to receive emails about the prize draw.”
- Done when: The QR code and the Kiosk link show, without the Save to activate badge.
- Go deeper: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/), [Play & Win: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/fields/)

### 11. On the iPad, scan the QR code, add the page to the Home Screen and lock the iPad to it with Guided Access.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “Open the link in Safari on the iPad: scan the QR code with its camera.” “Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and start Play & Win from the Home Screen: it runs full screen, in portrait or landscape.” “Lock the iPad to it with Guided Access (Settings, Accessibility, Guided Access; then triple-click the top button), and set Display & Brightness, Auto-Lock to Never while the stand is open.” “After each vote the page clears itself for the next visitor after 20 seconds.”
- Why: Kiosk votes are real entries: they show in Entries with the source Kiosk.
- Watch out: If the iPad shows “This page is not available.”, check that Kiosk is on and saved, and that the iPad opened the current link.
- Watch out: A new link, made with New link and saved, replaces the old one, which then stops working: scan the new QR code on the iPad.
- Watch out: To pause the kiosk, switch Kiosk off and save; switching it on again brings back the same link.
- Done when: Play & Win runs full screen on the iPad, from its Home Screen.
- Go deeper: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/), [How to replace the kiosk link](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/new-kiosk-link/)

## Stage 6: Close voting and draw the prize

Once the campaign is finished, voting is never open, on the kiosk too. Entries are deleted three weeks (21 days) after the event ends, so download them before then.

Sources: [How to close voting and show the result](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/finish/), [How to download the entries for the prize draw](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/download-entries/).

### 12. Under Result, switch Campaign finished on, type the Actual number and press Save Play & Win.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Campaign finished, under Result, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Voting closes, and attendees who voted see their guess beside the actual number on the final screen.
- Watch out: If App Studio says “Fix the highlighted fields before saving.”, fill in or correct the number: a whole number, digits only, up to 999,999,999, such as 13050.
- Done when: You saved with Campaign finished on and the actual number filled in.
- Go deeper: [How to close voting and show the result](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/finish/)

### 13. Before the draw, delete each test entry with its trash button in Entries, then Delete entry.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Keep it, Delete entry
- Why: Votes made while testing, in the app or on the kiosk, are real entries until you delete them.
- Watch out: Deleting cannot be undone: the entry leaves the prize draw for good.
- Done when: The list reloads without the entry.
- Go deeper: [How to delete an entry](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/delete-entry/), [How to try Play & Win before the event starts](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/test-early/), [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/)

### 14. In Entries, press Refresh, then Download CSV for the prize draw.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Refresh, Download CSV
- Why: The file lists every entry of the event, from the app or the kiosk, whatever the attendee's Networking setting.
- Watch out: Entries are deleted three weeks (21 days) after the event ends: download them before then.
- Done when: A file named play-win-[event]-[date].csv is on your computer.
- Go deeper: [How to download the entries for the prize draw](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/download-entries/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/)

## Something's wrong?

- **Ask the assistant warns that the AI assistant is not switched on.** Why: The app's AI assistant is set by your ExpoPlatform team, and without it this widget “would have nothing to open”. What to do: Ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/).
- **People cannot add a widget you switched on to their home screen.** Why: A widget ships with your next build: phones need a build made after you switched it on. What to do: Make a new build in Build & test and publish it as a new version; phones show the change once it is installed, and to have people on older versions asked, or made, to update, ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/).
- **The phone preview does not show my wording.** Why: The preview beside the page always shows Play & Win with the app's default texts and voting open, whatever you set. What to do: Save your texts: as App Studio says, “Attendees get it the next time they open Play & Win.” See: [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to change the wording of a Play & Win screen](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/edit-texts/).
- **Attendees do not see Play & Win in the app.** Why: The app shows the Play & Win row only to signed-in people, only when the event's menu carries the row, and only while the campaign is on. What to do: Check that Play & Win is on and saved for that event, and that it is in that event's menu in Menu & content; if it is not, ask your ExpoPlatform contact; people see it only once they are signed in. See: [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/).
- **People cannot vote, in the app or on the kiosk.** Why: Voting is open during the event's own dates, or earlier while Test mode is on, and never once the campaign is finished; the kiosk also needs Play & Win itself on. What to do: Switch Play & Win on and save; to open voting before the event starts, switch Test mode on and save. See: [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to try Play & Win before the event starts](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/test-early/), [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/).
- **The iPad shows “This page is not available.” instead of the game.** Why: The link is wrong, the kiosk is off or not saved, or the app is archived; the page never says which. What to do: Check that Kiosk is on and saved, and that the iPad opened the current link: after New link, save and scan the new QR code. See: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/), [How to replace the kiosk link](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/new-kiosk-link/).
- **“This email has already played.” shows on the kiosk.** Why: The typed e-mail already has an entry for this event, from the app or the kiosk. What to do: One e-mail plays once per event, in the app or on the kiosk: that e-mail's entry is already in Entries. See: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/).
- **The iPad shows “Couldn't load Play & Win”.** Why: The page could not reach the server; it tries again every 15 seconds. What to do: Check the iPad's connection: as the page says, “Check the connection. The page tries again by itself.” See: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/).
- **“Fix the highlighted fields before saving.” shows when you press Save Play & Win.** Why: The actual number or the Book a meeting link has a problem. What to do: Correct the highlighted field, then save: the actual number is a whole number, digits only, up to 999,999,999, and the link a full web address, or empty. See: [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/), [How to close voting and show the result](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/finish/), [How to set the game's picture and the Book a meeting link](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/picture-and-link/).

# Journey: Change content during the event

From a change you need during the event to installed apps showing it, with no new version.

**The result:** Installed apps show your changes to the menu, the home screen, pages and texts, for the right event and language, with no new version.

Sources: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/).

_App Studio Playbook v1.0.0, built from the App Studio guide v1.0.1, checked against App Studio bea65df on 14 Oct 2026. Each step links to the App Studio guide pages it comes from._

## Who does what

- **Your move**: You change the menu, the home screen, the pages in Custom pages and texts in App Studio, check them and save them.
- **Our team is on it**: Your ExpoPlatform team can also change the same menu, the pages in Custom pages and texts; for a new version, they approve your request to publish (they do by default) and start the rollout.
- **The store is on it**: For a new version, Apple and Google review it before it rolls out.

Sources: [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/), [How to follow a rollout](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-rollout/).

## Before you start, have ready

- Access to your ExpoPlatform admin: App Studio opens only from there, not from a link or a bookmark.
- A wide screen: the phone previews of Menu & content and Sign-in & registration show only on wide screens.
- Each change you need, with the event and the language it is for.
- Your words for each language the app offers: menu names, page texts and your wording in Translations are kept per language.

Sources: [Open App Studio](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/open/), [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/).

## Stage 1: Before the event

Most changes you save reach installed apps by themselves, the next time the app refreshes. Settle the icon, the name under it (in store builds, the store name), the splash picture and its colour, and which home-screen widgets are on before the event: they reach phones only with a new build.

Sources: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/).

### 1. Know which changes reach installed apps by themselves, and which need a new version.

- Who: Your move
- Reaches installed apps by itself: Colours & fonts, Home screen, Menu & content and Custom pages: at the next refresh; Sign-in & registration: at the next refresh; Texts in Translations: within about 30 minutes; Your choice of events in Events & updates: no new build; What a home-screen widget shows: no new build; Play & Win: no new build.
- Needs a new build and store release: The app icon; The name under the icon (in store builds, the store name); The splash picture and its colour; Switching a home-screen widget on or off.
- Why: Changes to the menu, the home screen, pages and texts need no new build.
- Watch out: Name, icon & splash shows the same save-bar line as the other sections, but phones show the icon, the name under it (in store builds, the store name), and the splash picture and its colour only after a new build is installed.
- Watch out: A home-screen widget's switch saves at once, with no save button, and reaches phones only with your next build.
- Done when: You know which of your changes need a new version.
- Go deeper: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Events & updates](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-general/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/)

## Stage 2: Open the right event and language

Menu & content, Home screen, Custom pages and Sign-in & registration keep most settings per event, and their texts per language. Your wording in Translations is per language, for every event of the app.

Sources: [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/).

### 2. Open App Studio from your admin, then your app, and the section you want to change.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The sections of your app, in the menu on the left of every page, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: The menu on the left holds every section: Menu & content under App, and Home screen, Custom pages and Translations under Look.
- Watch out: A session lasts up to 8 hours: when it ends, open App Studio again from your admin and make again any change that was not saved.
- Watch out: If an amber bar says “This page is from an older deployment, so saving does nothing”, copy out what you typed, press Reload in the bar and make the change again.
- Done when: The section is open, with your app's name in the top bar.
- Go deeper: [Open App Studio](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/open/), [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/)

### 3. Pick the event and the language you are changing, before you change anything.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Event, Language of the texts
- Why: In apps with several events, Home screen has an event select and Custom pages an event picker; the home's header texts and Custom pages pick the language with buttons such as EN and DE, and Translations has Language at the top of its list.
- Watch out: In Menu & content, Sign-in & registration and Events & updates, switching the event or the language drops unsaved changes without asking: save first.
- Watch out: Language of the texts starts on English each time you open the section.
- Watch out: In Sign-in & registration, only the button texts are kept per language: the sign-in mode, the addresses and the switches change for every language.
- Done when: The section shows the event and the language you want to change.
- Go deeper: [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [How to edit another event's home (apps with several events)](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/other-event/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/)

## Stage 3: Make the change

Each section saves with its own button, and a few actions save at once, without it.

Sources: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to put the home back to the default](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/restore-default/).

### 4. In Menu & content, rename, hide, move or add the event's menu items.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Section header, Bottom bar, Add to this section, Move up, Move down, Edit, Remove from the menu, Add
- Why: The change is for this event only, and item names are kept per language.
- Watch out: Save in an item's window saves the event's whole menu at once, with your other unsaved changes on the page.
- Watch out: Remove from the menu does not ask first, and once saved the item is gone in every language with its content: to keep it in App Studio, hide it instead.
- Watch out: A change made in an item's window shows in the phone preview only after its Save: check it then with View as.
- Done when: You pressed Save or Save changes, App Studio says “Saved”, and the phone preview shows the menu you want.
- Go deeper: [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/), [How to hide or remove an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/hide-or-remove/), [How to change the order of items in a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/reorder/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to limit who sees an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/limit-audience/)

### 5. In Home screen, add, hide, move or change the event's blocks.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Blocks: what the home shows, in order, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Each event has its own home, and Save home screen saves every event you edited since the last save.
- Watch out: Restore the default home is saved straight away, without Save home screen.
- Watch out: A block's bin takes it off the list at once, without asking: to keep its settings, switch the block off instead.
- Watch out: The phone shows your unsaved home on sample content.
- Done when: The phone preview shows the home you want, and after Save home screen App Studio says “Content saved — live on the next app fetch”.
- Go deeper: [How to add, order, hide and remove blocks](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/manage-blocks/), [How to edit another event's home (apps with several events)](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/other-event/), [How to put the home back to the default](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/restore-default/), [Home screen](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/), [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/)

### 6. In Custom pages, change or write the event's page, and press Save page.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Discard, Save page
- Why: Each page belongs to one event, and a saved page is “Live on the next app refresh. No new build needed.”
- Watch out: If someone else, such as your ExpoPlatform team, saved the page after you opened it, your save is refused: copy your text, reload, open the page again and make the change again.
- Watch out: When you press Add to menu or add a built-in screen in Custom pages, reload any other tab showing Menu & content before you save there, or that save takes it out again.
- Watch out: Who sees it does not protect a page: “everything on a page can be read by anyone who has your app.”
- Done when: The phone preview shows your page, and the save bar reads “Live on the next app refresh. No new build needed.”
- Go deeper: [How to write a page of your own](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/write-a-page/), [How to put a saved page in the menu](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/add-a-page-to-the-menu/), [How to change a page made before App Studio](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/edit-an-event-page/), [Custom pages](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/), [How to write a page in several languages](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/write-in-other-languages/), [How to add a built-in screen to the menu](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/add-a-built-in-screen/), [How to show a block only to guests or only to signed-in people](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/limit-a-block/)

### 7. In Translations, choose the language, find the text, type your wording and press the save button.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “Change any text the app shows, in each language. Leave a field empty to keep the standard text. No new build is needed.”
- Why: Installed apps pick up saved texts within about 30 minutes, with no new build; Translations has no phone preview.
- Watch out: Your wording applies to every event of the app, not to one event.
- Watch out: Menu names and the sign-in and registration button texts are not here: change them per event in Menu & content and Sign-in & registration.
- Watch out: To undo your wording, empty the field or press the arrow beside it, and save.
- Done when: App Studio says “Saved. Installed apps pick the texts up within about 30 minutes.”
- Go deeper: [How to change a text the app shows](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/change-a-text/), [How to go back to the standard text](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/back-to-standard/), [How to work on another language](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/another-language/), [Translations](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/), [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/)

## Stage 4: When phones show it

Installed apps show a saved change the next time they refresh, with no new build; only a few settings wait for a new version.

Sources: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/).

### 8. Check the change in the app on a phone: it shows at the next refresh, and texts within about 30 minutes.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: **Saved** “Changes reach the app the next time it refreshes.”
- Why: The app checks for new texts when it opens, when it comes back to the foreground and every 5 minutes while open, at most once every 30 minutes.
- Watch out: A change to the menu, the home's blocks or a page shows only in the event you saved it for; your wording in Translations shows in every event.
- Watch out: A picture or video you upload is stored at once, but the app uses it only after you save.
- Watch out: Your old apps never show what you save in Menu & content, Sign-in & registration or Events & updates: check every change on a phone with a build of this app, a test build from Build & test first.
- Done when: A phone with a build of this app shows your change.
- Go deeper: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/), [How to change a text the app shows](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/change-a-text/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [Glossary](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/glossary/)

### 9. For the icon, the splash picture or colour, or a widget switch, build a new version in Build & test.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The Build & test button at the top of every page of your app, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Phones show these only after the next build is installed: a test build first, then a store release from Publish.
- Watch out: In store builds, the name under the icon is the store name, not App name in the app, so a new build does not change it: ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Watch out: After the stores' review, a later version waits for your ExpoPlatform team to start the rollout (on Android, after a first 5%): ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Watch out: Whether people with an older version are asked, or made, to update is set by your ExpoPlatform team: ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Done when: Each new build ends Ready and reads Store-signed; if a ready build is not Store-signed, ask your ExpoPlatform contact to add your app's store key.
- Step by step: [Release a new version](update.md)
- Go deeper: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to build the app for a phone](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/start-a-build/), [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/), [How to install a test build on your phone](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/install-a-test-build/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to change the app's name in the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-identity/change-name/), [How to follow a rollout](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-rollout/)

## Something's wrong?

- **App Studio says “Your session has expired - reopen App Studio from your admin” or “Reopen App Studio from your admin”.** Why: Your App Studio session has ended, or could not start, and a save refused for that reason is not carried out. What to do: Open App Studio again from your ExpoPlatform admin, then make the change again and save it. See: [Open App Studio](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/open/).
- **My changes disappeared when I picked another event or language.** Why: In Menu & content, Sign-in & registration and Events & updates, switching the event or the language drops unsaved changes without asking. What to do: Make the changes again, and save before you switch. See: [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/).
- **A renamed menu item keeps its old name in another language.** Why: Item names are kept per language, and you renamed it in one. What to do: Pick each language in Language of the texts, rename the item there too, and save before you switch. See: [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/).
- **Saving the menu says “Every menu item needs a name”.** Why: An item has no name, for example a page from Custom pages that Menu & content shows as “Page title”, so the menu was not saved. What to do: Press Edit on that item, give it a name, and save again. See: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to add a feature, a custom page or a documents page to a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-item/), [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/).
- **The phone preview says “Live preview crashed” or “The app's config could not be loaded…”** Why: The app inside the preview stopped with an error, or the event server is not answering, so the preview cannot start. What to do: For “Live preview crashed”, press Retry; for the second message, try again in a minute. See: [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/).
- **Saving a page says “This page was changed by someone else — reload it before saving”.** Why: Someone else, such as your ExpoPlatform team, saved the page after you opened it. What to do: Copy any text you want to keep, reload the page, open your page again and make your changes again. See: [How to write a page of your own](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/write-a-page/), [Custom pages](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/).
- **The text I want to change is not in Translations.** Why: Menu names and the sign-in and registration button texts are worded per event, in Menu & content and Sign-in & registration. What to do: Change them there; for any other text, search with other words or with the text's key. See: [Translations](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/), [How to change a text the app shows](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/change-a-text/).
- **My change does not show on phones yet.** Why: A saved change shows at the next refresh, and a text within about 30 minutes, on a phone with a build of this app; a change you have not saved never reaches it, and your old apps never show what you save in Menu & content, Sign-in & registration or Events & updates. What to do: Check that the section shows your change for the right event and language, that you saved it, and that the phone has a build of this app; for a text, allow about 30 minutes. See: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [Glossary](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/glossary/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/).
- **My new icon, name, splash picture or widget does not show on phones.** Why: They reach phones only with a new build, and so does switching a widget on or off; in store builds, the name under the icon is the store name, not App name in the app. What to do: For the icon, the splash picture and its colour or a widget switch, make a new build, install it and publish it; for the name in store builds, ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to change the app's name in the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-identity/change-name/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/).

# Journey: Release a new version

From changes that need a new build to people getting the new version, for an app already in the stores.

**The result:** A new version of your app, tried on real phones first, has passed the stores' review and is rolling out to people.

Sources: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/).

_App Studio Playbook v1.0.0, built from the App Studio guide v1.0.1, checked against App Studio bea65df on 14 Oct 2026. Each step links to the App Studio guide pages it comes from._

## Who does what

- **Your move**: You make and save the changes, build and test the new version, write its What's new and ask to publish.
- **Our team is on it**: Your ExpoPlatform team approves your request to publish (they do by default), starts the rollout and sets the update prompts.
- **The store is on it**: Apple and Google review each release before people can download it.
