Sources: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/), [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/).

## Before you start, have ready

- What's new for each language of your store listing.
- Your testers: TestFlight needs at least one, and Google Play testers are Google Groups.
- A demo account the store reviewers can sign in with, on a demo event with at least 3 sessions on its agenda.

Sources: [How to write the store texts for a language](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/write-store-texts/), [How to send a build to your testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/send-to-testers/), [How to add or remove testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/manage-testers/), [How to give the store reviewers a demo account](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/add-demo-account/).

## Plan from the date the new version should reach people

Enter the date the new version should reach people, and the plan works back to the working day each step should be done by. The days are allowances you can change, and your ExpoPlatform team confirms the dates of their own steps. Working days are Monday to Friday: public holidays are not counted.

The days the plan allows, which you can change:

- Days allowed for the stores' review: 7 days. Your allowance, based on the stores' published figures: Apple is “typically reviewing at least 50% of submissions in less than 24 hours and 90% in less than 48 hours”; for certain developer accounts, Google Play's review can take “up to seven days or longer in exceptional cases”. ([Apple: App Review](https://developer.apple.com/distribute/app-review/), read 14 Oct 2026; [Google Play Console Help: Publish your app](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9859751), read 14 Oct 2026)
- Working days allowed for ExpoPlatform's approval: 2 days. Your assumption: there is no published time, and your ExpoPlatform team confirms the date.
- Days of testing on real phones: 5 days. Your assumption: the plan adds a day before testing for Apple to check a TestFlight build, “usually within a day”.

The plan, in order, worked back from the date you enter (the new version should reach people by):

- Changes for the new version saved (Your move): the date of the new test builds. What is built into the app comes from your app's settings at the time of the build.
- New builds sent to your testers (Your move): the ask date, less the testing days and one day, on a working day. Each platform takes one release at a time, test and store releases alike.
- What's new saved and the review check clear (Your move): the ask date. A release waits at Ready while Store review has something to sort out.
- Ask ExpoPlatform to publish (Your move): the approval date, less the approval's working days. Let each send to your testers finish first.
- ExpoPlatform approves the request (Our team is on it): the start of the stores' review. Each build then goes on to its store's review, and your ExpoPlatform team confirms the date.
- The stores review the new version (The store is on it): the rollout date, less the review days, on a working day. If a store turns the release down, a new release goes through ExpoPlatform's approval and the store's review again.
- Your ExpoPlatform team starts the rollout (Our team is on it): the date you enter, on a working day. Later iPhone versions, and Android beyond its first 5% stage, wait for this step, and your ExpoPlatform team confirms the date.
- The new version reaches people: the date you enter.

Sources: [How to send a build to your testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/send-to-testers/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/), [How to follow a release through the store's review](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-review/), [How to follow a rollout](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-rollout/).

## Stage 1: Decide what needs a new version

Most changes you save reach installed apps by themselves, the next time the app refreshes. What is built into the app reaches phones only with a new version.

Sources: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/).

### 1. Check whether your changes need a new version, or reach installed apps by themselves.

- Who: Your move
- Reaches installed apps by itself: Colours & fonts, Home screen, Menu & content and Custom pages: at the next refresh; Sign-in & registration: at the next refresh; Texts in Translations: within about 30 minutes; Your choice of events in Events & updates: no new build; What a home-screen widget shows: no new build; Play & Win: no new build.
- Needs a new build and store release: The app icon; The name under the icon (in store builds, the store name); The splash picture and its colour; Switching a home-screen widget on or off.
- Why: Phones show a change to what is built into the app only after the next build is installed: a test build first, then a store release.
- Done when: You know which of your changes need a new version.
- Go deeper: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/)

### 2. Make and save every change the new version should carry, before you build.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Name, icon & splash, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: A build takes the icon and the splash picture and its colour from your app's settings at the time it is made.
- Watch out: A home-screen widget's switch saves at once, with no save button, and switching it on or off reaches phones with your next build.
- Watch out: In store builds, the name under the icon is the app's store name, not App name in the app: ask your ExpoPlatform contact about the store name.
- Done when: Every change the new version should carry is saved.
- Go deeper: [Name, icon & splash](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-identity/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/), [How to change the app's name in the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-identity/change-name/), [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/)

## Stage 2: Build and test the new version

Test builds go to your testers with no approval from ExpoPlatform. Each platform takes one release at a time, test and store releases alike.

Sources: [How to send a build to your testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/send-to-testers/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/).

### 3. In Build & test, press Build for iOS, then Build for Android.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The Build & test button at the top of every page of your app, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Each build is made from the app code ExpoPlatform deploys, with your app's settings at the time of the build.
- Watch out: For Android, keep App Bundle (AAB): Google Play accepts only an App Bundle.
- Done when: Each build ends Ready and reads Store-signed; if a ready build is not Store-signed, ask your ExpoPlatform contact to add your app's store key.
- Go deeper: [How to build the app for a phone](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/start-a-build/), [How to follow a build, and stop it](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/follow-or-stop/), [How to install a test build on your phone](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/install-a-test-build/), [How to send a build to your testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/send-to-testers/)

### 4. Under Send to testers, send each new build to your testers, and try it on real phones.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Where should the build go? (TestFlight), Add testers, Build, Send
- Why: Sending needs no approval from ExpoPlatform, and on TestFlight “Apple checks the build first, usually within a day.”
- Watch out: Each platform takes one release at a time, store releases included: while your last version of a platform is still moving, you cannot send a build of that platform.
- Watch out: An amber Staged on Play badge means the Android release waits as a draft in Google Play Console until it is published there: ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Watch out: With a demo account saved in Publish, a TestFlight send first checks that its demo event is ready for review.
- Done when: You and your testers have tried the new version: on iPhone, the send shows Live on TestFlight.
- Go deeper: [How to send a build to your testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/send-to-testers/), [How to install a test build on your phone](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/install-a-test-build/), [How to add or remove testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/manage-testers/), [How to give the store reviewers a demo account](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/add-demo-account/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/)

## Stage 3: Update the store listing

The store listing is your app's page in the stores: one listing for both stores, with its texts in each language. A release at Ready is sent for review on its own, unless Store review still has something to sort out.

Sources: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to write the store texts for a language](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/write-store-texts/).

### 5. In Publish, on Store listing, write What's new for each language and save each one.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): App name, Short description, Description, What's new, Save English
- Why: A build's Details can give you lines for it: under For the store's “What's new”, press Copy.
- Watch out: Switching language tabs keeps your unsaved texts on the page, but only the save button stores them.
- Watch out: Ask your ExpoPlatform contact what each store will show as What's new for this version.
- Done when: App Studio says “[language] texts saved”, and the listing reads Changes not sent.
- Go deeper: [How to write the store texts for a language](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/write-store-texts/), [How to see what changed in a build](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/see-changes/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/)

### 6. Under Store review, press Check again, and fix anything marked Your move.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Demo login, Demo password, Demo event number, Notes for the reviewers, Check again, Save demo account
- Why: Store reviewers sign in to your app with this account, and a release waits at Ready while Store review has something to sort out.
- Watch out: If it says “The demo event looks empty”, pick a demo event with at least 3 sessions on its agenda, or add sessions to it.
- Watch out: If it says “The demo event could not be checked”, check the login, the password and the event number, and save them again.
- Done when: Store review reads Ready for review.
- Go deeper: [How to give the store reviewers a demo account](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/add-demo-account/), [How to check what is left before the app can go to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/check-what-is-left/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/)

## Stage 4: Ask to publish

One request sends both stores their build. ExpoPlatform approves it, and the stores review it.

Sources: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/).

### 7. On Releases, press Submit to the stores, keep each store's newest build, and press Submit.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): App Store (ticked), Build, Google Play (ticked), Build, Close, Submit
- Why: Each store with a finished build starts ticked, with its newest build chosen.
- Watch out: Let each send to your testers finish first: a request approved while a test send of the same platform is still on its way cannot start.
- Done when: App Studio says “Sent to ExpoPlatform for approval”, or “Sent to the stores” for an app that needs no approval.
- Go deeper: [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/)

### 8. Your ExpoPlatform team approves the request.

- Who: Our team is on it
- On screen: “Waiting for ExpoPlatform approval: App Store [version], Google Play [version], sent [when].”
- Why: When they approve, each build becomes a store release on its way to the store's review.
- Watch out: A declined request reads “Declined: [reason]”, or “Declined: no reason given”: sort out what the reason names and submit again, or ask your ExpoPlatform contact when no reason is given.
- Done when: Releases says “Approved [when]: [the builds] went to the stores' review. Follow it below.”
- Go deeper: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/)

### 9. Apple and Google review the new version; follow it on Releases.

- Who: The store is on it
- A store release's statuses: Draft, Uploading, Processing, Ready, Submitted, In review, Approved, Rolling out, Live.
- Why: Apple typically reviews 90% of submissions in less than 48 hours; for certain developer accounts, Google Play's review can take up to seven days, or longer in exceptional cases. (Sources: [Apple: App Review](https://developer.apple.com/distribute/app-review/), read 14 Oct 2026; [Google Play Console Help: Publish your app](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9859751), read 14 Oct 2026)
- Watch out: If a store turns the release down, its card shows the store's message when it gave one, and a new release goes through Submit to the stores and ExpoPlatform's approval again.
- Watch out: Cancel release does not take a release out of the store's review: App Studio stops following it, and a review in progress carries on.
- Watch out: If your event is close and the iPhone version is still in review, your ExpoPlatform team can ask Apple to expedite the review, and Apple decides. (Source: [Apple: App Review](https://developer.apple.com/distribute/app-review/), read 14 Oct 2026)
- Done when: The release reads Approved.
- Go deeper: [How to follow a release through the store's review](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-review/), [How to cancel a store release](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/cancel-release/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [Publish](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/)

## Stage 5: Roll it out

Once a store approves, a later iPhone version, and Android beyond its first 5% stage, wait for your ExpoPlatform team, who start the rollout.

Sources: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to follow a rollout](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-rollout/).

### 10. Your ExpoPlatform team starts the rollout; follow it on Rollout.

- Who: Our team is on it
- On screen: the App Store card, “5 of 6 steps done”: Set up Done, Build Done, Test Done, Store listing Done, Publish Waiting, Live Done. What now (Our team is on it): “Approved by the store”, “The rollout starts on its own and reaches people step by step.”, with the button **Open rollout**.
- Why: Only an app's first iPhone version and Android's first 5% stage go out by themselves: later iPhone versions, and Android beyond 5%, wait for your ExpoPlatform team.
- Watch out: What now says “The rollout starts on its own and reaches people step by step.”, but for a later version that holds only for Android's first 5% stage: ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Watch out: If What now says “The rollout is stopped”, ExpoPlatform is looking at it: ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Done when: The release reads Rolling out, and Live once everyone can get this version.
- Go deeper: [How to follow a rollout](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-rollout/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to follow a release through the store's review](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-review/), [How to check what is left before the app can go to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/check-what-is-left/)

### 11. On Your apps, check which version people can download from each store.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Your apps, with each app's store badges, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Under App Store and Google Play, the first badge is what people can download now, and a second badge, when there is one, shows the newest release on its way.
- Watch out: A second badge reading Approved means the release passed the store's review and waits for your ExpoPlatform team to start the rollout.
- Done when: The first badge names your new version, such as “Live · 1.94.4”.
- Go deeper: [Your apps](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/your-apps/)

## Stage 6: Bring people onto the new version

Your ExpoPlatform team sets whether people on older versions are asked, or made, to update, and Analytics shows which versions phones run.

Sources: [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/).

### 12. Your ExpoPlatform team sets the update rules, if older versions should be asked, or made, to update.

- Who: Our team is on it
- On screen: “Older versions are asked, or made, to update when the app starts.”
- Why: Below the Must update version, people must update before they can use the app; below Asked to update, they are asked and may skip it.
- Watch out: These rules are set by your ExpoPlatform team: to change a rule or the wording of a prompt, ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Watch out: A rule for a version that is not fully live in that store yet waits, and the app is told the rule only once that version is fully live.
- Done when: App updates on your app's Overview shows the rules you asked for.
- Go deeper: [Your app's Overview](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/overview/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/)

### 13. In Analytics, open the Devices tab to see which versions phones run.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The Devices tab, with its Versions chart, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Versions counts the installs on each version of your app over the last 30 days, each install once, under the version it reported last.
- Done when: Your new version shows under Versions, with its installs.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Devices](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/devices/), [How to see which phones run one app version](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/phones-on-a-version/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/)

## Something's wrong?

- **My new icon, name, splash picture or widget does not show on phones.** Why: They reach phones only with a new build, and so does switching a widget on or off; in store builds, the name under the icon is the store name, not App name in the app. What to do: For the icon, the splash picture and its colour or a widget switch, make a new build, install it and publish it; for the name in store builds, ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to change the app's name in the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-identity/change-name/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/).
- **A choice in Send to testers is greyed out.** Why: The app is not in that store yet, there is no Store-signed build of that platform, another release of that platform is still moving (a store release included), or, on Android, an earlier release waits as a draft or the newest build is already on another Google Play track. What to do: Read the reason the dialog gives and do what it says; if new builds are not Store-signed, or a release waits as a draft in Google Play Console, ask your ExpoPlatform contact; while another release is still moving, wait until it has finished. See: [How to send a build to your testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/send-to-testers/).
- **A TestFlight send says “Failed to submit release”.** Why: The release was created but not sent; with a demo account saved in Publish, its demo event may not be ready for review, or its saved login cannot be used. What to do: Check the demo account under Store review in Publish, then press Send again: it continues the same release. See: [How to send a build to your testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/send-to-testers/), [How to give the store reviewers a demo account](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/add-demo-account/).
- **A release is stuck at Ready.** Why: Store review still has something to sort out, such as a missing demo account, a demo account the check cannot sign in with, or a demo event that looks empty. What to do: Open Store review in Publish and fix each item marked Your move; items marked Our team are your ExpoPlatform team's. See: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to give the store reviewers a demo account](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/add-demo-account/).
- **Releases says “Approved, but the stores could not take it yet”.** Why: ExpoPlatform approved, but publishing could not start: each platform takes one release at a time, and another release of that platform, such as a test send, was still on its way. What to do: Nothing: ExpoPlatform is on it. See: [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/), [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/).
- **A store turned the release down.** Why: The store found a problem; its card shows the store's message when it gave one. What to do: Fix it, build again if needed, and ask again with Submit to the stores: the new release goes through ExpoPlatform's approval and the store's review again. See: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to follow a release through the store's review](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-review/).
- **The store approved the new version, but it is not reaching people.** Why: Later iPhone versions, and Android beyond its first 5% stage, wait for your ExpoPlatform team to start the rollout. What to do: Ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to follow a rollout](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-rollout/), [Your apps](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/your-apps/).
- **What now says “The rollout is stopped”.** Why: The rollout was halted, and ExpoPlatform is looking at it. What to do: Ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to follow a rollout](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-rollout/).
- **People on older versions are not asked to update.** Why: App updates reads Off when no rule is set, and a rule for a version that is not fully live in that store yet waits until it is. What to do: Check App updates on your app's Overview, and ask your ExpoPlatform contact to set or change a rule. See: [Your app's Overview](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/overview/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/).

## Facts from outside App Studio

- [Apple: App Review](https://developer.apple.com/distribute/app-review/), read 14 Oct 2026: "App Review works around the clock, typically reviewing at least 50% of submissions in less than 24 hours and 90% in less than 48 hours. … if your app is still in review and the launch of your event is quickly approaching, you can request to have your app review expedited."
- [Google Play Console Help: Publish your app](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9859751), read 14 Oct 2026: "For certain developer accounts, we'll take more time to thoroughly review your app to help better protect users. This may result in review times of up to seven days or longer in exceptional cases."

# Journey: See how people use the app

From a live app to numbers you can read, narrow and share.

**The result:** You can read how people used your app in a period: who opened it, what they looked at and which features they used, and you know how each number is counted.

Sources: [After launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/), [Analytics](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/), [How the numbers are counted](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/how-numbers-are-counted/).

_App Studio Playbook v1.0.0, built from the App Studio guide v1.0.1, checked against App Studio bea65df on 14 Oct 2026. Each step links to the App Studio guide pages it comes from._

## Who does what

- **Your move**: You open Analytics in App Studio, choose what to look at, read the numbers and export them for your team, sponsors or exhibitors.

Sources: [Analytics](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/), [How to export a PDF report or CSV files](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/export/).

## Before you start, have ready

- Your app live on people's phones: the numbers come from the installed app.
- The event and the days you want to read: one event or all of them, and a period of up to 92 days.
- Who needs the numbers: colleagues open Analytics from their own admin, or you send them a PDF report or CSV files.

Sources: [After launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/), [Analytics](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/), [How to narrow the numbers to one event, platform or user type](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/narrow/), [How to see how much the app was used in a period](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/read-the-period/), [How to keep the view you are looking at](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/share-a-view/), [How to export a PDF report or CSV files](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/export/).

## Stage 1: Open Analytics

Analytics is in App Studio's sidebar under After launch. Its eight dashboard tabs, from Overview to Tech, share one filter bar, and the filters stay as you switch tabs.

Sources: [How to see how much the app was used in a period](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/read-the-period/), [Analytics](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/).

### 1. Open your app in App Studio, then Analytics under After launch in the sidebar.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The Overview tab, ringed, here with 90 days chosen; Whole screen shows Analytics chosen in the sidebar under After launch, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Once your app is live, Analytics shows how it is used: who opens it, what they look at, which features they use and how fast it runs.
- Watch out: The numbers come from the installed app, and a phone appears in Devices once it has opened a version of the app built in App Studio.
- Done when: Analytics opens on Overview, with the last 30 days.
- Go deeper: [Analytics](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/), [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/), [How to see how much the app was used in a period](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/read-the-period/), [After launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/)

### 2. Under Period, press 7d, 14d, 30d or 90d, and under Event, choose an event or keep All events.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Event and Period at the top of Analytics, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: A period is whole days in UTC, today included, and at most 92 days long.
- Watch out: For other dates, press the date button, pick the first and the last day, and press Apply: closing the calendar drops them.
- Watch out: With an event chosen, only what people did while that event was chosen in the app counts.
- Done when: The line beside the date button repeats your dates and the number of days.
- Go deeper: [How to see how much the app was used in a period](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/read-the-period/), [How to narrow the numbers to one event, platform or user type](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/narrow/), [How the numbers are counted](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/how-numbers-are-counted/), [Analytics](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/), [Analytics: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/fields/)

### 3. If a tab says “No activity in this period”, press Show the last 90 days or Clear filters when offered.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: **No activity in this period** “Numbers appear here as soon as people use the app. Try a longer period, or fewer filters.”
- Why: A tab shows this only when nothing in it can be drawn.
- Watch out: If neither button shows, choose other dates in the calendar, up to 92 days.
- Watch out: Clear filters drops the event, platform and user type but keeps the period.
- Watch out: Audience and Tech can show cards while other tabs are empty: some of their cards read the phones' own check-ins.
- Done when: The tab is read again with the longer period or without the filters.
- Go deeper: [How to get numbers on a tab that says 'No activity in this period'](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/empty-tab/), [Analytics: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/fields/)

## Stage 2: Read the headline numbers

The six Overview tiles each compare the period with the same number of days just before. How to read says what a number means, and Latest activity how fresh it is.

Sources: [Analytics: Overview](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/overview/), [How to find out what a number means](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/read-a-definition/), [How to check how fresh the numbers are and read them again](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/check-freshness/).

### 4. On Overview, read the six tiles against the days just before, then Daily activity below them.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “Previous period: [value]” “Same as the previous period” “Nothing to compare in the previous period”
- Why: People, Signed in, Devices, Sessions, Avg. session and Screen views are each compared with the same number of days just before: green is better, red is worse.
- Watch out: The days of Daily activity do not add up to the tiles: each day counts its own people.
- Watch out: Someone who used the app before signing in, and then signed in during the same period, counts twice under People: once as the phone and once as the account.
- Watch out: A session with a single action counts as 0 minutes and pulls Avg. session down.
- Done when: You know how each headline number moved against the days just before.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Overview](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/overview/), [How to see how much the app was used in a period](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/read-the-period/), [How the numbers are counted](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/how-numbers-are-counted/)

### 5. Press How to read at the top right to open the Analytics guide on the part for your tab.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): How to read, Export, Refresh
- Why: Each entry is named like the card on screen and says what it shows, how it is counted and which app records it comes from.
- Done when: You read the entry named like the card you are looking at.
- Go deeper: [How to find out what a number means](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/read-a-definition/), [How the numbers are counted](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/how-numbers-are-counted/), [Analytics: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/fields/)

### 6. Read Latest activity under the heading, and press Refresh to read the open tab again.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: The line under the Analytics heading, here with nothing recorded in the period, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Latest activity says when the newest activity under your filters was recorded, from just now to a date once it is 14 days or more, or the line reads “No activity in this period yet”.
- Watch out: Refresh reads only the open tab: another tab keeps the numbers it read for the same filters until you press Refresh there.
- Watch out: The Analytics guide says a phone without a connection keeps its records for up to 30 days, so a period that has just ended can still grow a little.
- Watch out: Data completeness on Tech, measured only with All events, shows the share of the phones' records that has arrived, and says “Some data still on its way” below 99%.
- Done when: You know when the newest activity was recorded, or that none was, and the open tab is read again.
- Go deeper: [How to check how fresh the numbers are and read them again](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/check-freshness/), [Analytics: Tech](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/tech/)

## Stage 3: See what people did

Audience, Engagement, Content, Networking and Promotion share the filter bar with Overview.

Sources: [Analytics](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/).

### 7. Open Audience to see who people are, where they come from and whether they come back.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: New vs returning, ringed at the top of the Audience tab, empty in this period, beside Languages, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Install sources shows how each new install first opened the app: from a link, a QR code, the store with no link, or a link the app could not read.
- Watch out: Installs and updates counts an install when the app is first opened, not when it is downloaded from the store.
- Watch out: With one event chosen, new in New vs returning still means new to the app, not to that event.
- Watch out: Where people are places phones by the network they use, so a phone on mobile data or a VPN can be placed in its operator's country.
- Done when: You know where new installs came from and, day by day, how many devices were new or came back.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Audience](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/audience/), [How to see where installs came from](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/install-sources/)

### 8. Open Engagement to see when people used the app, the screens and features they used, and their searches.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “Activity by weekday and hour.” “What people did in the app, and how many of them did it.” “Terms at least three people searched for.”
- Why: Searches flags a term when 25% or more of its searches found nothing.
- Watch out: When people use the app shows each phone's local time, while the period is in UTC days, so its first and last hours can be cut differently.
- Done when: You know which screens and features people used most.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Engagement](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/engagement/), [How the numbers are counted](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/how-numbers-are-counted/)

### 9. Open Content for the exhibitors, products, sessions, speakers, brands, documents and videos people looked at.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “Views per impression in a list”
- Why: Each row of the top table gives views, people, favourites, impressions and CTR; exhibitors add Booth located and Meetings asked, and sessions Added to agenda.
- Watch out: CTR can pass 100%, because a profile can also be opened from search, a link or another profile.
- Watch out: Favourites that were later removed still count in the top table; Favourites shows how many were removed.
- Done when: You know which items people viewed most.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/content/)

### 10. Open Networking to see the meetings, messages, leads and personal agendas of the period.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “From the request to the rating.” “Messages sent, chats started and chats people opened to read.” “Badges scanned in the app, and what became of the leads.”
- Why: Meetings follows requests to the meetings accepted and rated, and those declined, cancelled and rescheduled.
- Watch out: Each meeting step counts what happened in the period, not one set of meetings followed through, so accepted can be more than requested.
- Watch out: Meeting attendance shows 0% and “Low attendance” whenever a meeting was accepted, and Contact requests stays empty: the Analytics guide says the app does not offer a meeting check-in or contact requests yet.
- Done when: You know how many meetings were requested and accepted in the period.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Networking](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/networking/)

### 11. Open Promotion to see how sponsor placements, push notifications, links and QR codes reached people.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “[n] clicks on sponsored places.” “Impressions per place in the app, with the click rate.” “QR codes scanned and downloaded in the app.”
- Why: Sponsors gives the impressions, clicks and CTR of each sponsor in each place its banner was shown.
- Watch out: The Analytics guide says a sponsor impression counts when at least half of the banner was on screen for at least a second, once per screen visit.
- Watch out: The Analytics guide says Received misses pushes that arrived while the app was not on screen unless they were tapped, so the open rate can pass 100%, while Opened is complete.
- Done when: You know how often sponsor banners were seen and clicked, and how many pushes were opened.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Promotion](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/promotion/)

## Stage 4: See how the app ran, and on which phones

Performance and Tech show how fast and how reliably the app worked. Devices lists every phone with your app that has reported in, and works on its own.

Sources: [Analytics: Performance](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/performance/), [Analytics: Tech](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/tech/), [Analytics: Devices](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/devices/).

### 12. Open Performance for speed and server answers, and Tech for versions, phones, permissions and reliability.

- Who: Your move
- On screen: “Cold: from tapping the icon to the first screen people can use. Warm: from coming back to the app to its first frame.” “The typical cold start, with the slowest 5% beside it.” “How the sampled calls to the server were answered.”
- Why: Lower is better everywhere on Performance: Typical is the median, and Slowest 5% the 95th percentile.
- Watch out: Errors people saw on Tech leaves out app crashes; your ExpoPlatform team can see more about the app's health, such as crashes and errors: ask your ExpoPlatform contact.
- Done when: You know how fast the app started and how reliably it worked in the period.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Performance](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/performance/), [Analytics: Tech](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/tech/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/)

### 13. Open Devices to see the phones with your app, the versions they run and who is signed in on each.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Installs, last 30 days, ringed among the Devices tab's install figures; Whole screen shows the tab chosen, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Versions shows which app versions phones ran over the last 30 days, and Show devices lists the phones on one of them.
- Watch out: The dashboard's filters, Latest activity and Export do not apply here: use the tab's own Search, Platform, App version and Signed in filters.
- Watch out: The list shows personal data: the name and email, or company, of the person signed in on each phone, and a city and country located from its network.
- Done when: You see the install figures and the versions in use.
- Go deeper: [Analytics: Devices](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/devices/), [How to see which phones run one app version](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/phones-on-a-version/), [How to find the phones of one person](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/find-a-person/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/)

## Stage 5: Narrow to a slice

Platform and User type read every dashboard tab again for that slice, except a few cards.

Sources: [How to narrow the numbers to one event, platform or user type](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/narrow/).

### 14. Under Platform, choose iOS or Android, and under User type, choose Visitor, Exhibitor, Speaker or Guest.

- Who: Your move
- Picture: Platform and User type, under Event, a screenshot of App Studio
- Why: Each choice applies at once: the open tab is read again, then the other tabs, and the filters stay as you switch tabs.
- Watch out: Languages, Where people are, Top cities, Operating systems and Phones ignore the user type, and Data completeness and the people counts in the Event list ignore both.
- Watch out: The Analytics guide says older app versions do not report the user type: their activity drops out as soon as you choose one.
- Watch out: Filters are not saved: a reload of your admin's page in the same browser tab keeps them, but a new browser tab opens your list of apps.
- Done when: The open tab shows that slice, and Reset filters brings back every event, platform and user type and the last 30 days.
- Go deeper: [How to narrow the numbers to one event, platform or user type](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/narrow/), [How the numbers are counted](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/how-numbers-are-counted/), [How to keep the view you are looking at](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/share-a-view/), [Analytics: Tech](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/tech/)

## Stage 6: Share the numbers

Export turns the eight dashboard tabs into a PDF report or CSV files, for the filters set at that moment. The Devices tab is never exported.

Sources: [Analytics](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/), [How to export a PDF report or CSV files](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/export/).

### 15. Press Export, choose a format and the sections, and press Make the PDF or Make the CSV files.

- Who: Your move
- On screen (drawn from App Studio's code): Format (PDF report), Sections to include (ticked), Make the PDF
- Why: App Studio's own words: “Turn what you see into a branded report for your team, sponsors or exhibitors”.
- Watch out: The file uses the filters set when you press Export: set Event, Period, Platform and User type first.
- Watch out: The file can be downloaded for one hour from when it was made.
- Watch out: If the dialog names a section it could not prepare, the file says it is missing: export again to include it.
- Done when: “Your report is ready” shows, and Download PDF or Download ZIP saves the file.
- Go deeper: [How to export a PDF report or CSV files](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/export/), [How to keep the view you are looking at](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/share-a-view/)

## Something's wrong?

- **A tab says “No activity in this period”.** Why: Nothing in the tab can be drawn for your period and filters. What to do: Press Show the last 90 days or Clear filters when offered; if neither shows, choose other dates in the calendar, up to 92 days. See: [How to get numbers on a tab that says 'No activity in this period'](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/empty-tab/).
- **A tab says “These numbers could not be loaded right now” instead of its cards.** Why: The tab could not be read. What to do: Press Try again. See: [How to see how much the app was used in a period](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/read-the-period/).
- **People is higher than Signed in and Devices suggest.** Why: Someone who used the app before signing in, and then signed in during the same period, counts once as the phone and once as the account. What to do: Nothing to fix: Signed in counts only accounts, and Devices counts installed copies of the app. See: [Analytics: Overview](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/overview/), [How the numbers are counted](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/how-numbers-are-counted/).
- **The numbers seem older than they should be.** Why: A tab keeps the numbers it read for the same filters until you press Refresh there, and Latest activity does not move on its own. What to do: Press Refresh on that tab, then read Latest activity again. See: [How to check how fresh the numbers are and read them again](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/check-freshness/).
- **The Devices tab ignores your filters.** Why: Devices reads each phone's latest check-in, so the dashboard's filters, Latest activity and Export do not apply to it. What to do: Use its own Search, Platform, App version and Signed in filters. See: [Analytics: Devices](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/devices/).
- **Some cards do not change when you choose a user type.** Why: Languages, Where people are, Top cities, Operating systems and Phones ignore the user type, and Data completeness and the people counts in the Event list always cover every user type. What to do: Nothing to fix: How the numbers are counted lists what each filter does not narrow. See: [How to narrow the numbers to one event, platform or user type](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/narrow/), [How the numbers are counted](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/how-numbers-are-counted/), [Analytics: Tech](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/tech/).
- **Export says “The report could not be made. Your data is safe; try again in a minute.”** Why: The export failed, and no file was made. What to do: Press Try again in a minute. See: [How to export a PDF report or CSV files](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/export/).
- **A link does not open your view for a colleague.** Why: App Studio opens only inside each person's own ExpoPlatform admin, so a link cannot open the view. What to do: Ask them to open Analytics from their own admin and choose the same tab and filters, or send them an export. See: [How to keep the view you are looking at](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/share-a-view/).
- **Export says “This report is no longer kept”.** Why: The file was kept for one hour and is gone. What to do: Press Try again and make the report again. See: [How to export a PDF report or CSV files](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/analytics/export/).

# Journey: Fix a problem

What App Studio's messages mean, and what to do when something does not work.

**The result:** You know what went wrong and what to do about it, and when to ask your ExpoPlatform team.

Sources: [Messages, word for word](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/messages/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/).

_App Studio Playbook v1.0.0, built from the App Studio guide v1.0.1, checked against App Studio bea65df on 14 Oct 2026. Each step links to the App Studio guide pages it comes from._

## Who does what

- **Your move**: You read what App Studio says and fix what App Studio lets you change.
- **Our team is on it**: Your ExpoPlatform team looks after what App Studio leaves to them.

Sources: [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/).

## Stage 1: Find out what is wrong

App Studio's own messages say what happened, and the guide lists them word for word, with where each one shows.

Sources: [Help](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/), [Messages, word for word](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/messages/).

### 1. Note what App Studio says, word for word, and where it says it.

- Who: Your move
- Why: The guide's search finds most messages by a few of their words.
- Done when: You have the message's words, or you know which step of a journey you are on.
- Go deeper: [Messages, word for word](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/messages/)

### 2. Pick what you see from the problems below.

- Who: Your move
- Why: Each problem says why it happens and what to do, and opens the journey step it belongs to.
- Done when: You found your problem, or none of them fits.
- Go deeper: [Help](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/), [Messages, word for word](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/messages/)

### 3. Not listed? Find the message on Messages, word for word in the guide.

- Who: Your move
- Why: It lists App Studio's messages by section, with where each one shows.
- Done when: You found the message and the section it shows in.
- Go deeper: [Messages, word for word](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/messages/), [Help](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/)

### 4. If a picture or a text was refused, check Limits, sizes and formats in the guide.

- Who: Your move
- Why: It lists every limit App Studio puts on a field, by section.
- Done when: You know the limit the field has.
- Go deeper: [Limits, sizes and formats](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/limits/)

### 5. If App Studio leaves it to your ExpoPlatform team, ask your ExpoPlatform contact.

- Who: Your move
- Why: Set by your ExpoPlatform team lists what App Studio does not let you change, by section.
- Done when: You asked your ExpoPlatform contact about the item, by its name in the guide.
- Go deeper: [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/)

## Something's wrong?


### In "Launch your event app" ([the journey](launch.md))

- **The build buttons are greyed out.** Why: ExpoPlatform has not finished setting the app up in the stores, or did not set it up. What to do: Read the note above the list: while the set-up runs, wait, and ask your ExpoPlatform contact if you need to know where it stands; if it says “ExpoPlatform did not set this app up in the stores”, ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to build the app for a phone](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/start-a-build/).
- **Publish says “Not in the stores yet”.** Why: The store set-up is not finished. What to do: Read the line under it: while your request waits, wait until the set-up is done; once ExpoPlatform is putting your app in the stores, ask your ExpoPlatform contact if this takes longer than a working day; if they did not set it up, ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to check what is left before the app can go to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/check-what-is-left/).
- **My new icon, name, splash picture or widget does not show on phones.** Why: They reach phones only with a new build, and so does switching a widget on or off; in store builds, the name under the icon is the store name, not App name in the app. What to do: For the icon, the splash picture and its colour or a widget switch, make a new build, install it and publish it; for the name in store builds, ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to change the app's name in the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-identity/change-name/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Home-screen widgets](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/).
- **The phone preview does not open on my designed home.** Why: Designed home screen is off (“When off, the app opens on its first menu screen and this design is not used.”), or the Preview strip below the form starts the preview on My Badge or Boot flow. What to do: Switch Designed home screen on and press Save home screen, or choose Home in the Preview strip. See: [How to turn the designed home screen on or off](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/designed-home-on-off/), [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/).
- **A build has been running for a long time.** Why: It may have stopped: an amber note on its card says so. What to do: Stop it and start a new one. If your builds keep failing, ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to follow a build, and stop it](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/follow-or-stop/).
- **A choice in Send to testers is greyed out.** Why: The app is not in that store yet, there is no Store-signed build of that platform, another release of that platform is still moving (a store release included), or, on Android, an earlier release waits as a draft or the newest build is already on another Google Play track. What to do: Read the reason the dialog gives and do what it says; if new builds are not Store-signed, or a release waits as a draft in Google Play Console, ask your ExpoPlatform contact; while another release is still moving, wait until it has finished. See: [How to send a build to your testers](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/builds/send-to-testers/).
- **Submit to the stores is greyed out.** Why: A request is already waiting for ExpoPlatform. What to do: Wait for their decision; it shows on Releases. See: [How to ask ExpoPlatform to publish the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/ask-to-publish/).
- **A release is stuck at Ready.** Why: Store review still has something to sort out, such as a missing demo account, a demo account the check cannot sign in with, or a demo event that looks empty. What to do: Open Store review in Publish and fix each item marked Your move; items marked Our team are your ExpoPlatform team's. See: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to give the store reviewers a demo account](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/add-demo-account/).
- **A store turned the release down.** Why: The store found a problem; its card shows the store's message when it gave one. What to do: Fix it, build again if needed, and ask again with Submit to the stores: the new release goes through ExpoPlatform's approval and the store's review again. See: [From test build to the stores](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/journey/), [How to follow a release through the store's review](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/release/publish/follow-review/).
- **The Overview says “Not in the stores yet”, but people can download the app.** Why: The Overview counts a store as live only from App Studio's own store record. What to do: Check the live version on Your apps. See: [Your app's Overview](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/overview/).

### In "Make the app look like your event" ([the journey](look.md))

- **“Text on this colour is hard to read ([ratio]:1).” shows under Primary.** Why: The Tertiary colour on your Primary colour has a contrast below 4.5:1. What to do: Press the button beside it, which reads Use and a darker colour's code, or change Primary or Tertiary; the note is advice, and saving is not blocked. See: [How to fix a hard-to-read brand colour](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/design/fix-contrast/).
- **After Save changes, a red message says a colour must be a #RRGGBB code.** Why: A colour is not a #RRGGBB code, so nothing was saved. What to do: Correct it to # followed by six characters from 0 to 9 and a to f, then press Save changes again. See: [How to change an event's colours](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/design/change-event-colours/).
- **The phone preview does not open on my designed home.** Why: Designed home screen is off (“When off, the app opens on its first menu screen and this design is not used.”), or the Preview strip below the form starts the preview on My Badge or Boot flow. What to do: Switch Designed home screen on and press Save home screen, or choose Home in the Preview strip. See: [How to turn the designed home screen on or off](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/designed-home-on-off/), [Find your way around](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/find-your-way/).
- **After Save home screen, a red message shows, and nothing is saved.** Why: A block's settings break its rules, a header Text colour is not a #RRGGBB code, or a header line in another language has no English text. What to do: Correct what the message names, then press Save home screen again. See: [How to add, order, hide and remove blocks](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/manage-blocks/), [How to write the words at the top of the home](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/home/write-header/).
- **Save page is off, with lines listed above it.** Why: The page breaks a rule, such as a title or a Text block without English: “Fix what is listed above to save.” What to do: Fix each line listed, for example an English title of 1 to 40 characters, and English text or a picture in each Text block. See: [How to write a page of your own](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/write-a-page/), [How to write a page in several languages](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/write-in-other-languages/).
- **Saving a page says “This page was changed by someone else — reload it before saving”.** Why: Someone else, such as your ExpoPlatform team, saved the page after you opened it. What to do: Copy any text you want to keep, reload the page, open your page again and make your changes again. See: [How to write a page of your own](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/write-a-page/), [Custom pages](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/).
- **My new page is not in the menu.** Why: It was saved with Add to the menu when saved off, or a save in Menu & content, open in another tab, took it out. What to do: Press Add to menu under Not in the menu; if the Event section is full, make room there, in Menu & content. See: [How to put a saved page in the menu](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/add-a-page-to-the-menu/), [How to write a page of your own](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/write-a-page/).
- **Language is locked in Translations.** Why: You have unsaved changes: “Save your changes before switching the language”. What to do: Save your changes, or undo each one, then choose the language. See: [How to work on another language](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/another-language/).
- **My new wording does not show on phones yet.** Why: A phone with a build of this app installed picks up saved texts within about 30 minutes, and your wording is kept per language. What to do: Allow about 30 minutes, check on a phone with a build of this app installed, and set your wording in each language people use; if App Studio said texts could not be saved, press the save button again. See: [How to change a text the app shows](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/change-a-text/), [Translations](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/translations/).

### In "Let people sign in and register" ([the journey](sign-in.md))

- **Sign-in & registration asks you to choose the events in Events & updates first.** Why: No event is chosen for the app yet, and these settings are kept per event. What to do: In Events & updates, choose the event or the event tags and save, then choose an event in Event. See: [How to choose how people sign in to an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/choose-sign-in-mode/), [Events & updates](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-general/).
- **Events & updates says “No event has a tag yet. Tag your events in your admin first.”** Why: Several events, by event tag is chosen, and no event in your ExpoPlatform admin has a tag yet. What to do: Tag your events in your ExpoPlatform admin, then come back. See: [How to make the app offer several events, chosen by event tag](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-general/choose-events-by-tag/).
- **My changes disappeared when I picked another event or language.** Why: In Menu & content, Sign-in & registration and Events & updates, switching the event or the language drops unsaved changes without asking. What to do: Make the changes again, and save before you switch. See: [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/).
- **A change I made under one language shows in every language.** Why: Only the button texts are kept per language; the sign-in mode, the addresses and the switches hold one value for every language. What to do: Set those once for each event, and write only the button texts in each language. See: [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/).
- **The register button does not show on the sign-in screen.** Why: It shows only while Show the register button is on and there is a registration address to open. What to do: Switch it on and save; with Another website, fill in Registration website, and with The event's registration page, the event needs a registration page of its own to open. See: [How to let new visitors register from the sign-in screen](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/add-register-button/), [Sign-in & registration: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/fields/).
- **Saving says “This could not be saved - try again” or “Reopen App Studio from your admin”.** Why: The first means the save did not go through, and your edits stay in the form; the second means your App Studio session has ended. What to do: For the first, press Save changes again; for the second, open App Studio again from your ExpoPlatform admin and make the change again. See: [How to choose how people sign in to an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/choose-sign-in-mode/), [Open App Studio](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/open/).
- **There is no phone beside the form, or it shows “Loading the preview…” or “The app's config could not be loaded…”** Why: The preview shows only on wide screens and can stay loading when its data is refused; the second message means the preview could not get what it needs to start. What to do: Use a wider window; if it stays loading, wait a moment, then open the section again; for the second message, try again in a minute. See: [How to check the sign-in screen before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/check-preview/).
- **The sign-in screen still shows the old pictures.** Why: Sign-in & registration cannot change them, and its preview draws the event's stored ones; Colours & fonts sets them, and the app uses them only after Save changes there. What to do: In Colours & fonts, with the right event picked, set them under Pictures, press Save changes, and check them there with Boot flow. See: [How to check the sign-in screen before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/check-preview/), [How to change the sign-in pictures and the loading backdrop](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/design/change-sign-in-pictures/), [Colours & fonts: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/design/fields/).
- **Phones still show the old sign-in screen.** Why: Installed apps show saved changes the next time they refresh, and only saved changes reach them; your old apps never show them. What to do: Check that you saved each event and language you changed, and that the phone has a build of this app, such as a test build from Build & test; it then shows them at its next refresh. See: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to check the sign-in screen before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/check-preview/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/).

### In "Build the menu and content" ([the journey](menu.md))

- **A page I put in the menu from Custom pages is gone from it.** Why: Menu & content was already open in another tab, and its save took the page out of the menu again. What to do: Put the page back with Add to menu in Custom pages, then reload Menu & content before you save there. See: [How to put a saved page in the menu](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/pages/add-a-page-to-the-menu/).
- **Menu & content only asks you to choose the event, or the event tags, in Events & updates.** Why: The app's event, or for an app with several events its event tags, is not chosen yet. What to do: Choose them in Events & updates and save, then pick an event in Event. See: [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Events & updates](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-general/).
- **My changes disappeared when I picked another event or language.** Why: In Menu & content, Sign-in & registration and Events & updates, switching the event or the language drops unsaved changes without asking. What to do: Make the changes again, and save before you switch. See: [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/).
- **What I want to add is not in Add to this section.** Why: It offers only the features switched on for the event and not already in the section, and A custom page or A documents page only while the event has a free place of that kind. What to do: Look for the item in the section, perhaps marked “Hidden”; a feature not switched on for the event, or a kind of page with no free place, cannot be added here. See: [How to add a feature, a custom page or a documents page to a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-item/), [Glossary](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/glossary/).
- **Saving the menu says “Every menu item needs a name”.** Why: An item has no name, for example a page from Custom pages that Menu & content shows as “Page title”, so the menu was not saved. What to do: Press Edit on that item, give it a name, and save again. See: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to add a feature, a custom page or a documents page to a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-item/), [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/).
- **The Bottom bar switches are greyed out, or App Studio says “At most 4 items fit in the bottom navigation”.** Why: All four places are taken, a hidden item with Bottom bar on included, or more are on, for example items taken over from the old App Builder. What to do: Switch items off until four or fewer are on, then save; to add another tab, switch one off first. See: [How to put items in the bottom bar](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/bottom-bar/), [How to hide or remove an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/hide-or-remove/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [Menu & content: field reference](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/fields/).
- **An item does not show for some people.** Why: It is hidden, limited under Visible for, a custom page shown to guests only, or in a section those people do not see. What to do: Check its row for “Hidden” or “Limited to some people”, a custom page's window for Only for people who are not signed in, and the menu in the preview with View as. See: [How to limit who sees an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/limit-audience/), [How to hide or remove an item](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/hide-or-remove/), [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [How to show a custom page to guests only](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/guests-only-page/).
- **There is no phone preview beside the menu.** Why: The preview shows only on wide screens. What to do: Open Menu & content on a wide screen. See: [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/).
- **A saved change does not show on phones yet.** Why: Installed builds of this app get saved changes the next time they refresh; an app made before App Studio never gets them, and a phone without a build of this app has nothing to refresh. What to do: Check that App Studio said “Saved”, then look on a test build of this app from Build & test after its next refresh. See: [When your changes reach the app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/changes-reach-the-app/), [How to check the menu before saving](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/check-in-preview/), [Your old App Builder settings](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/old-app-builder/), [Add a new app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/new-app/).

### In "Get people using the app" ([the journey](engage.md))

- **Ask the assistant warns that the AI assistant is not switched on.** Why: The app's AI assistant is set by your ExpoPlatform team, and without it this widget “would have nothing to open”. What to do: Ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/).
- **People cannot add a widget you switched on to their home screen.** Why: A widget ships with your next build: phones need a build made after you switched it on. What to do: Make a new build in Build & test and publish it as a new version; phones show the change once it is installed, and to have people on older versions asked, or made, to update, ask your ExpoPlatform contact. See: [How to offer a home-screen widget in your app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/widgets/switch-on/), [Update your app after launch](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/after/updating/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/).
- **The phone preview does not show my wording.** Why: The preview beside the page always shows Play & Win with the app's default texts and voting open, whatever you set. What to do: Save your texts: as App Studio says, “Attendees get it the next time they open Play & Win.” See: [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to change the wording of a Play & Win screen](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/edit-texts/).
- **Attendees do not see Play & Win in the app.** Why: The app shows the Play & Win row only to signed-in people, only when the event's menu carries the row, and only while the campaign is on. What to do: Check that Play & Win is on and saved for that event, and that it is in that event's menu in Menu & content; if it is not, ask your ExpoPlatform contact; people see it only once they are signed in. See: [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [Set by your ExpoPlatform team](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/help/set-by-team/).
- **People cannot vote, in the app or on the kiosk.** Why: Voting is open during the event's own dates, or earlier while Test mode is on, and never once the campaign is finished; the kiosk also needs Play & Win itself on. What to do: Switch Play & Win on and save; to open voting before the event starts, switch Test mode on and save. See: [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/), [How to try Play & Win before the event starts](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/test-early/), [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/).
- **The iPad shows “This page is not available.” instead of the game.** Why: The link is wrong, the kiosk is off or not saved, or the app is archived; the page never says which. What to do: Check that Kiosk is on and saved, and that the iPad opened the current link: after New link, save and scan the new QR code. See: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/), [How to replace the kiosk link](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/new-kiosk-link/).
- **“This email has already played.” shows on the kiosk.** Why: The typed e-mail already has an entry for this event, from the app or the kiosk. What to do: One e-mail plays once per event, in the app or on the kiosk: that e-mail's entry is already in Entries. See: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/), [Play & Win](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/).
- **The iPad shows “Couldn't load Play & Win”.** Why: The page could not reach the server; it tries again every 15 seconds. What to do: Check the iPad's connection: as the page says, “Check the connection. The page tries again by itself.” See: [How to set up the stand iPad kiosk](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/set-up-kiosk/).
- **“Fix the highlighted fields before saving.” shows when you press Save Play & Win.** Why: The actual number or the Book a meeting link has a problem. What to do: Correct the highlighted field, then save: the actual number is a whole number, digits only, up to 999,999,999, and the link a full web address, or empty. See: [How to run Play & Win for an event](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/run-play-win/), [How to close voting and show the result](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/finish/), [How to set the game's picture and the Book a meeting link](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/play-win/picture-and-link/).

### In "Change content during the event" ([the journey](live.md))

- **App Studio says “Your session has expired - reopen App Studio from your admin” or “Reopen App Studio from your admin”.** Why: Your App Studio session has ended, or could not start, and a save refused for that reason is not carried out. What to do: Open App Studio again from your ExpoPlatform admin, then make the change again and save it. See: [Open App Studio](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/start/open/).
- **My changes disappeared when I picked another event or language.** Why: In Menu & content, Sign-in & registration and Events & updates, switching the event or the language drops unsaved changes without asking. What to do: Make the changes again, and save before you switch. See: [Per event, per language or for the whole app](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/look/scope/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/), [Sign-in & registration](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-sign-in/).
- **A renamed menu item keeps its old name in another language.** Why: Item names are kept per language, and you renamed it in one. What to do: Pick each language in Language of the texts, rename the item there too, and save before you switch. See: [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/), [How to choose the event and the language you edit](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/choose-event-and-language/).
- **Saving the menu says “Every menu item needs a name”.** Why: An item has no name, for example a page from Custom pages that Menu & content shows as “Page title”, so the menu was not saved. What to do: Press Edit on that item, give it a name, and save again. See: [Menu & content](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/), [How to add a feature, a custom page or a documents page to a section](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/add-item/), [How to rename an item or change its icon](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/build/app-menu/rename-and-icon/).
- **The phone preview says “Live preview crashed” or “The app's config could not be loaded…”** Why: The app inside the preview stopped with an error, or the event server is not answering, so the preview cannot start. What to do: For “Live preview crashed”, press Retry; for the second message, try again in a minute.
